items.title: jingyaogong/minimind
items.contentSnippet:
🧠 两小时从 0 训出你的 64M 大模型。Train your own 64M LLM from scratch in 2 hours.
https://jingyaogong.github.io/minimind

 
 

 
 
 
 
     
 
 
 
 

 
 
 
 
"大道至简"
 
 
 
 
中文 | English
 
 
 
 
此开源项目旨在完全从 0 开始，仅用 3 块钱成本与 2 小时训练时间，即可训练出规模约为 64M 的超小语言模型 MiniMind。
 
 
MiniMind 系列极其轻量，主线最小版本体积约为 GPT-3 的 $\frac{1}{2700}$，力求让普通个人 GPU 也能快速完成训练与复现。
 
 
项目同时开源了大模型的极简结构与完整训练链路，覆盖 MoE、数据清洗、预训练（Pretrain）、监督微调（SFT）、LoRA、RLHF（DPO）、RLAIF（PPO / GRPO / CISPO）、Tool Use、Agentic RL、自适应思考与模型蒸馏等全过程代码。
 
 
MiniMind 同时拓展了视觉模态模型 M

I made Dimmer Switch.

And sometimes I just want what I'm looking at to look cool.

This started as a visual companion to a search for undiscovered objects across 14 telescope archives (including Rubin, Euclid, and DECam).

items.title: Show HN: Slate, a C to Rust Transpiler for multiple targets
items.contentSnippet: Hey HN, For the past half year I've been working on Slate, my C to Rust transpiler. Slate parses C code as gcc/clang/msvc would, and then translates code to rust. The best supported "flavor" as I call them is clang, with clang flavor I've been able to translate the Linux kernel (built for x86_64 defconfig) and booted the built vmlinux to a busybox shell.
